title: DIWALI - Diversity and Inclusivity aWare cuLture specific Items for India: Dataset and Assessment of LLMs for Cultural Text Adaptation in Indian Context
reasoning: The paper explicitly benchmarks 'Religion' as one of its 17 core cultural facets. It includes religious concepts and customs (e.g., Buddhism, Chathurthi Vrat, and Bon) in its DIWALI dataset and evaluates the performance of LLMs in adapting text related to these religious traditions across various sub-regions of India.
